elements.evidence: The clause binds both parties, so Customer remains prohibited from soliciting specified employees of the other party.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: It is limited to employees “who are directly involved in performing the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: It applies during the employee’s involvement and for twelve months thereafter.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly excludes “unsolicited approaches by an employee.”

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative restriction prohibits solicitation only and contains no prohibition on hiring.
